name: PI-Terminal
description: A terminal in the right work panel: local shells and SSH sessions with a real pty, tabs, session persistence, and agent read/write over the terminal. Inspectable but never silently destructive.
author: Sunrise

agentTools.name: read
agentTools.description: Read recent output from a terminal session as text (secrets are redacted). Use the returned nextSeq as fromSeq for the next call to read only new output.

fromSeq.description: Read output whose block sequence is >= this value. Omit to read the most recent screen.

agentTools.name: send
agentTools.description: Type text into a terminal session, optionally pressing Enter, and return the output produced afterwards. Multi-line text is written verbatim (each newline is executed/pressed), so prefer one command per call. This runs commands on the user's machine, so the host asks for confirmation first.

text.description: Text to type. Do not append a newline yourself.

waitMs.description: How long to wait for output after writing, in milliseconds (default 2500, max 20000). Output that stays quiet for 800 ms ends the wait early.

agentTools.name: wait
agentTools.description: Wait until a terminal session stops producing output (quiet window) or a timeout passes, then return the new output. Useful after send for long-running commands.

fromSeq.description: Start reading from this sequence (default: only output produced while waiting).

quietMs.description: Consider output finished after this much silence (default 1200).

timeoutMs.description: Give up waiting after this long (default 15000, max 60000).

agentTools.name: upload
agentTools.description: Copy data to the machine behind an SSH session, over that session's own authenticated connection. Three shapes, chosen by what you pass: (1) inline text — content with encoding="utf8" (or encoding="base64" for binary); (2) one local file — localPath pointing at a file, uploaded to remotePath; (3) a whole local folder — localPath pointing at a directory, whose contents are copied into the remotePath directory (created if missing). remotePath must be absolute. stream=false (default) transfers with parallel chunks (fastPut/fastGet, and uploadDir/downloadDir's fast variants): fastest on large files but needs server support for the extended requests. stream=true uses a single readable/writable stream (put(readable) / get(remotePath, writable), useFastput:false / useFastget:false for folders): works on any server. 32 MiB limit for inline content.

remotePath.description: Absolute path on the remote host (target file, or target directory when uploading a folder).

content.description: Inline content: UTF-8 text, or base64 when encoding="base64". Mutually exclusive with localPath.

encoding.description: How to interpret content (default utf8). Only used with content.

localPath.description: Absolute path on this machine: a file to upload, or a folder whose contents are uploaded. Mutually exclusive with content.

mode.description: Octal file mode, default 644 (applies to files, not to folder uploads).

stream.description: Use a single readable stream instead of parallel chunks (default false).

agentTools.name: download
agentTools.description: Copy data from the machine behind an SSH session to this machine, over that session's own authenticated connection. A file with localPath is saved there (parent folders are created); a file without localPath is returned inline as text/base64 when it fits the inline limit. A folder always needs localPath and is copied recursively into it. remotePath must be absolute. stream=false (default) transfers with parallel chunks (fastPut/fastGet, and uploadDir/downloadDir's fast variants): fastest on large files but needs server support for the extended requests. stream=true uses a single readable/writable stream (put(readable) / get(remotePath, writable), useFastput:false / useFastget:false for folders): works on any server.

remotePath.description: Absolute path on the remote host: a file, or a directory to copy recursively.

localPath.description: Absolute path on this machine: the target file, or the target folder for a directory download. Omit to get a small file's content back inline.

encoding.description: How to return inline content (default utf8, or base64 when the bytes are not valid UTF-8).

maxBytes.description: Inline limit in bytes (default 262144, max 1048576). Ignored when localPath is given.

stream.description: Use a single writable stream instead of parallel chunks (default false).

agentTools.name: session
agentTools.description: Manage terminal sessions (tabs). action=list returns id/kind/title/status/cwd/seq/active (active marks the tab the user is looking at); action=create opens a local shell (optionally a specific shell binary and working directory) or an SSH session for a saved profile; action=close ends a session and the process or remote shell behind it — pass sessionId="*" to close every session. Omitted index parameters never mean "all": the call is refused instead of acting on every item. action=close therefore requires "sessionId" (use "*" for all of them).

sessionId.description: action=close: id from action=list (required), or "*" to close every session.

profileId.description: action=create with kind=ssh: id from profile action=list.

cwd.description: action=create with kind=local: absolute directory to start in (defaults to the project root).

shell.description: action=create with kind=local: shell to start — a command name resolved on PATH (e.g. nu, bash) or an absolute path (e.g. C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe). No arguments. Defaults to the plugin's default shell setting.

agentTools.name: profile
agentTools.description: Manage saved SSH connections. action=list shows id/name/host/user/auth (never passwords); action=create adds one; action=update changes an existing one; action=delete removes it together with its stored credentials; action=test opens a short-lived connection to verify the host key and authentication, then closes it. Omitted index parameters never mean "all": the call is refused instead of acting on every item. update/delete/test therefore require "profileId". Passwords and key passphrases are never accepted: the user enters those in the panel.

name.description: create/update: display name; defaults to the host.

group.description: create/update: free-text group; empty string moves it out of any group.

host.description: create/update: hostname or IP address (not a URL).

privateKeyPath.description: create/update: absolute path to the private key when auth=key; empty string clears it.

initialCommand.description: create/update: command to run after login.

jump.description: create/update: jump hosts, in connection order (max 4).

agentTools.name: setting
agentTools.description: Manage terminal settings. action=list returns every setting with its default; action=get returns one key (requires "key"); action=update applies an explicit patch given as "settings"; action=reset restores defaults. Omitted index parameters never mean "all": the call is refused instead of acting on every item. action=get and action=reset therefore require "key", and resetting everything requires key="*" explicitly.

key.description: get/reset: the setting key to act on (required). Use "*" with action=reset to reset every setting. One of: defaultShell, defaultCwdMode, scrollback, bufferBytes, maxSessions, fontSize, fontFamily, cursorBlink, confirmMultilinePaste, relayEnabled, sshKeepaliveSeconds.

settings.description: update: an explicit patch, e.g. { "fontSize": 14, "cursorBlink": false }. Only known keys are accepted; wrong types are reported instead of ignored; out-of-range numbers are clamped.

en.name: PI-Terminal
en.description: A terminal in the right work panel: local shells and SSH sessions with a real pty, tabs, session persistence, and agent read/write over the terminal. Inspectable but never silently destructive.
en.safetyNotes: Runs commands locally through a real pty (fancy-pty helper) and remotely over SSH (ssh2) inside the plugin's own process. Terminal output never leaves the machine except over the SSH connection the user configured. Credentials: private keys and ssh-agent are preferred and never copied; when a password is stored it is encrypted at rest with the OS keystore (DPAPI / Keychain / libsecret) under the plugin data directory, shown in clear only on an explicit reveal action that is audited. Host keys are verified and stored in OpenSSH known_hosts format; a changed fingerprint refuses the connection. File transfers (upload/download) run over the same already-authenticated SSH connection using ssh2-sftp-client: no second handshake and no second credential use. Agent tools are split by risk: reading is low risk, writing to a terminal and moving files are high risk and ask the user before they run. No telemetry and no third-party server. The UI follows the application language (English and Simplified Chinese); local terminals inherit the system PATH, including entries added after the host application started.

zh-CN.name: PI-Terminal
zh-CN.description: 右侧工作面板里的终端：本地 shell 与 SSH 远程会话（真实 pty）、多标签、会话持久化，并允许模型读取与写入终端内容。可审阅，但绝不静默执行破坏性操作。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 在插件自己的进程内通过真实 pty（fancy-pty helper）执行本地命令，并通过 SSH（ssh2）执行远程命令。终端内容除走用户自己配置的 SSH 连接外不会离开本机。凭据：优先使用私钥与 ssh-agent 且从不复制；若保存密码，则用操作系统密钥库（DPAPI / Keychain / libsecret）加密后存放在插件数据目录，只有在用户显式点开小眼睛时才返回明文，且该动作写入审计。主机指纹按 OpenSSH known_hosts 格式校验并保存，指纹变化时拒绝连接。文件上传与下载复用同一条已认证的 SSH 连接，由 ssh2-sftp-client 完成，不会再握手一次、也不会二次使用凭据。模型工具按风险分级：读取为低风险，写入终端与搬运文件为高风险并在执行前询问。无遥测、无第三方服务器。界面跟随应用语言（英文与简体中文）；本地终端继承系统 PATH，包括宿主机启动后新加入的条目。
